name: tmux-fleet
title: tmux-fleet | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: See the work across your terminals.
description: Bring a fleet of tmux sessions into view. Find the sessions waiting for attention, read their output, and give your agent the context to help.
caption: Workflow illustration.
flow_title: From scattered sessions to a clear next step.
flow_intro: Bring a fleet of tmux sessions into view. Find the sessions waiting for attention, read their output, and give your agent the context to help.
steps: List sessions and see which ones are active, finished, or waiting for attention.
Inspect session output and exit status, or ask for an interpretation.
Send input or create a session with explicit confirmation for that invocation.
detail_title: Expertise your agent can put to work.
details: Use fleet-wide attention ordering to focus on the sessions that need you.
Bring model-backed triage and interpretation to retained terminal context.
Read-only inspection and explicit write confirmation keep observation separate from action.
prompt: Use tmux-fleet to inspect my terminal sessions. Read tmux-fleet --help, list sessions, and summarize what needs attention. Ask before sending input or creating a session.
prerequisites: Python 3.13+, uv, and tmux. Follow the setup guide for socket access and provider extras.
model_note: Triage and interpretation use a configured model provider. Session inspection and explicit terminal operations run without one.
